class_id: a provenance write drops the lineage its caller holds
feature: any write path that holds a document's lineage ({method, docType, documentId, sourceSha, ...}) and writes some of its values through a shared door (upsertIPO -> DataConsolidationService -> FieldSourcesRepository.trackFieldUpdate) that has no parameter for it
symptom: The caller builds one lineage object and passes it to the provenance rows it writes itself, but a value it hands to a shared writer is recorded with whatever lineage that writer builds on its own (for ipos: only { policyOrigin }, or null). The row's source says a document supplied the value while the row cannot say WHICH document, so any reader that needs the document (the item 6 DOC fetcher, OD-91 receipts comparison, supersession) either guesses (the fetcher falls back to the first COMPLETED document of the family) or cannot act. Nothing fails: the row exists, the source is right, the value is right, and the gap is invisible until someone asks which document.
first_seen: 2026-09-25 -- #993: scraper/src/services/filing-persister.ts persistFilingExtraction passed `lineage` (with documentId) to every child-table and ipo_details field_sources row but called upsertIPO(deps.ipoRepository, scraped, source, existing, contextFields) without it. Measured on ipodhan_staging 2026-09-25 (read-only): 331 of 331 field_sources rows with table_name='ipos' and source='DRHP' had no data_lineage.documentId (251 with null lineage, 80 with only policyOrigin), across 58 IPOs. Other tables are NOT uniformly affected (ipo_details 281 with / 37 without, financial_data 284 with / 0 without), which localises the drop to the ipos door. Note, measured the same day: the item 6 probe's NO_DOCUMENT_PROVENANCE count (264 of 360 class rows) is NOT caused by this class -- those 264 are 213 plan rows with no field_sources row at all and 51 owned by CHITTORGARH/NSE; the effect of this class is on SUPPLIED answers, whose documentId falls back to a guess.
fix_prs: #993 fix: upsertIPO gains a lineage argument that the filing persister fills with its existing lineage object; DataConsolidationService merges it (ConsolidateIPODataInput.incomingLineage, provenanceLineage()) into a provenance row ONLY when that row is written for the incoming source, never onto a row kept under another owner; OD-73's no-restamp rule is untouched. Existing rows: scraper/scripts/repair-ipos-lineage-document-id.ts (dry-run default, --expect-db required, prod refused without --allow-prod; stamps documentId only where exactly one COMPLETED filing of the IPO completed within 10 s after the row's write, otherwise leaves the row and lists it).
detection_check: d_ipos_doc_lineage_document_id (docs/reviews/detection-checks/d_ipos_doc_lineage_document_id.json) -- any DRHP-source ipos provenance row written in the last 24h with no documentId. Covers the ipos door only; a child table whose writer drops the id is not covered by this predicate (ipo_details 37, ipo_risk_factors 3402, ipo_intermediaries 676 rows without documentId on staging 2026-09-25, cause unmeasured).
